limitations: This is an expanded review area, not a guarantee that every informal or unadvertised fishing arrangement has been found.
Public parking passes alone do not make a location paid fishing.
The new band is the convex hull of the previous 361 general map locations plus an approximate ten-mile outward buffer. It is not a road isochrone.
Outer examples can take roughly 2–2.5 hours from Vancouver; visitors retain their selected drive filter, which now supports up to 150 minutes.
Private club area markers do not establish a legal entrance. New unresolved records remain inactive and have no coordinate navigation.

additionalDecisions.name: Long Lake Park, Lacey
additionalDecisions.reason: WDFW explicitly prohibits fishing at the city park. The separate WDFW launch bank is mapped instead.

additionalDecisions.name: Hebo Lake
additionalDecisions.reason: Official recreation and ODFW material establish a trout fishery; corrected imagery was inspected, but the road estimate is 155 minutes. It remains a farther lead beyond the expanded 150-minute screen.

additionalDecisions.name: Nisqually refuge banks
additionalDecisions.reason: Bank fishing along the Nisqually River and McAllister Creek within the refuge is prohibited. Nearby river access must use separate authorized property.

additionalDecisions.name: Nisqually Trout Farms
additionalDecisions.reason: The current operator page describes live fish stocking for pond owners and U-fish businesses; it does not establish public customer fishing.
